scope: One-loop canonical supersymmetric SU(5) gauge matching, degenerate adjoint triplet and octet, one heavy MSSM Higgs triplet pair, four additional five-bar pairs in the 1769 split low spectrum. No gauge-kinetic Planck operator; aggregate flavor-blind dimension-six Wilson transfer A defined separately. Fix the light MSSM Higgsino mass in tree matching and retain its tiny signed contribution to the colored-triplet coupling correction. The three measured gauge couplings all calibrate the solution.
